name: jig-review
description: Configurable parallel reviews and bounded review-fix loops with Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor/Grok.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-model reviews and bounded fix loops
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for selecting isolated Claude Code, native Codex, and Cursor Agent with Grok 4.6 review subagents, running them in parallel over the same scope, and deduplicating their findings. Includes a persisted review-fix controller with task contracts, balanced causal repairs by default, minimal and comprehensive investigation modes, bounded repair rounds, validation, recoverable file application, and fresh reviews over working-tree or branch scopes. Comprehensive review defaults to Claude plus Codex; the review-fix loop defaults to native Codex.
defaultPrompt: Review my changes with Claude and Codex
